set +e; URL='https://e.givesmart.com/events/KHN/'; sudo -u azureuser /usr/bin/google-chrome --headless=new --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --virtual-time-budget=20000 --dump-dom "$URL" 2>/dev/null > /tmp/giv2.html; echo '--- script-embedded JSON with ticket/price keys ---'; python3 << 'PY'

    s=m.group(1)
    if any(k in s.lower() for k in ['price','ticket','amount','cost','table','seat','sponsor']):
        try:
            obj=json.loads(s)
            print(json.dumps(obj, indent=2)[:2000])
            print('---')
        except Exception: 
            pass
for m in re.finditer(r'\$\s?\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+(?:\.\d+)?', h):
    pass
print('=== inline $-amounts ===')
amounts=set(re.findall(r'\$\s?\d{1,3}(?:,?\d{3})+(?:\.\d+)?|\$\s?\d+(?:\.\d+)?', h))
print(sorted(amounts, key=lambda x:float(x.replace('$','').replace(',','').strip()) if x.replace('$','').replace(',','').replace('.','').strip().isdigit() else 0))
PY
